trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(dp:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(dt:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WHERE c.city_name <> 'Los Angeles' OR CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) < 1967 RETURN DISTINCT p.mvp_awards AS col1, t.championships AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
